summary.result: As a result, it was possible to confirm three landslides and the related activities on the northwest slope and the dumping activity on the west slope of FWOPM.
summary.background: Mining activity causes environmental pollution and geological hazards such as ground subsidence or landslide of which continuous monitoring is necessary.
summary.method: By using the difference between the two Digital Elevation Models (DEM) of the area, it was possible to confirm that there was a stockpiling activity in the western area of the FWOPM while excavation activity in the eastern area.
